business_summary: Hengtong Logistics Co., Ltd. engages in the logistics business in China. It is involved in road freight logistics, transportation, LNG energy trade logistics, and terminal leasing activities. The company also offers general cargo transportation, transportation vehicles, transportation fleet services, and hazardous chemicals transportation. In addition, it provides oil and gas and bulk commodity trading; port construction and operation; clean energy solutions; full logistics services; and intelligent transportation system research and development. In addition, the company engages in liquefied natural gas (LNG) leasing; and provision of road transport, driver training, and petroleum gas services, as well as cargo warehousing, loading, unloading, and shipping agency services. Further, it provides information systems, hardware and software solutions, logistics agency, cargo transportation, dangerous goods transportation, tallying, motor vehicle maintenance and repair, technical, agency, leasing, enterprise management consulting, port investment and construction, dangerous chemicals transportation, and road general cargo transportation services; and engages in computer software and hardware development and sales, material sales, gas business, natural gas wholesale, gas stove assembly, trade, and investment activities. Additionally, the company engages in ship repair, leasing, road freight transportation, dangerous goods transportation, construction engineering, logistics business, mining investment business, and international trade business. The company was formerly known as Longkou Hengtong Transportation Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Hengtong Logistics Co., Ltd. in December 2011. Hengtong Logistics Co., Ltd. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Yantai, China.
business_summary_ko: Hengtong Logistics Co., Ltd.는 중국에서 물류 사업을 영위하고 있습니다. 도로 화물 물류, 운송, LNG 에너지 무역 물류, 터미널 임대 활동에 참여하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 또한 일반 화물 운송, 운송 차량, 운송 차량 서비스 및 유해 화학 물질 운송을 제공합니다. 또한 석유, 가스 및 대량 상품 거래도 제공합니다. 항구 건설 및 운영; 청정 에너지 솔루션; 완전한 물류 서비스; 지능형 교통 시스템 연구 및 개발. 또한 회사는 액화천연가스(LNG) 임대업에도 종사하고 있습니다. 도로 운송, 운전자 교육, 석유가스 서비스 제공, 화물 창고, 선적, 하역 및 운송 대행 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 정보 시스템, 하드웨어 및 소프트웨어 솔루션, 물류 대행, 화물 운송, 위험물 운송, 집계, 자동차 유지 관리 및 수리, 기술, 대리점, 임대, 기업 경영 컨설팅, 항만 투자 및 건설, 위험 화학 물질 운송 및 도로 일반 화물 운송 서비스를 제공합니다. 컴퓨터 소프트웨어와 하드 분야에 종사합니다.
